source.name: Minnesota United: 'Target Becomes Official Partner And Kit Sponsor'
source.quote: Target is now the official partner and kit sponsor, joining MNUFC in a multi-year deal that will showcase the Target bullseye logo prominently on the 2017 kits.
source.note: The page's publication date (2017-01-19) is from its datePublished metadata; the page body shows no date line. Forbes (Jan 19, 2017) reported the same day that financial terms were not disclosed; no club-specific deal value has been found, so value stays null.
